sources.label: Scout 247+Rivals+ESPN 2027/2028 frozen ingest
sources.detail: Frozen Scout board. Composite stars = avg of 247sports_composite, on3_rivals (else on3_industry, never both), ESPN. Rankings use precomputed school talentScore.

notes: High schools are ranked, not colleges.
School talentScore is the Scout precomputed sum of 2027+ player points.
Player composite = average of 247sports_composite, on3_rivals (else on3_industry, never both), and ESPN.
Matchup week is 2026-08-26 through 2026-08-29. Unmapped opponents stay on /games with 0 talent.
SEED: top Scout schools + Matchup week games until the full 1,554/2,986 dump is imported. Recruits are frozen ingest rows, not invented.
